lead.headline: Likely 3.2, Wilson 4.6, Jets 1 — the week is gone; claim Loveland
lead.deck: You trail 119.76 to 81.82 with only Pickens left; ESPN gives you 1%. The claim that matters clears Wednesday at 01:00.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Isaiah Likely caught two passes for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start, Garrett Wilson had 4.6 on three targets while Geno Smith threw three touchdowns, the Jets D/ST scored 1 as Miami put up 28, and Matthew Golden was banged up in the second quarter at Detroit before returning for 9.9 on 12 targets. Josh Jacobs did his job — 20.1 on 16 touches in his first game back — but Furia Regia lead 119.76 to 81.82 and only Pickens is left tonight. The week's real decision is Wednesday's: Kmet's ACL ends his season, Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8, and Colston Loveland is still on waivers — claim him and drop C.J. Stroud, whose bye-cover job is done.
